authoring_contract.conductivity_law: sigma_void + ((1-c) sigma_0(T) + c sigma_1(T) - sigma_void) * occupancy**penalty; sigma_k(T)=sigma_k+slope_k (T - T_initial)
authoring_contract.induced_field: E_ind = -1/2 (B_n - B_{n-1})/(t_n - t_{n-1}) x (r - r_g); r_g = induction_gauge_origin_m, or the domain centre when it is null (allowed only without terminals or without a changing field, where r_g only shifts the potential gauge)
authoring_contract.induction_gauge_origin: point to which the external circuit leads run straight from every terminal, so its return path links no further flux; required when terminals and a changing field coexist
authoring_contract.body_force: f = J x B_n on the native solid momentum rows (element force / 4 per node)
authoring_contract.torque: M = sum_e (r_e - moment_reference_m) x V_e f_e over native tetrahedron centroids r_e
authoring_contract.coordinate_frame: native analysis frame in m: origin at the lower-corner node, node (i,j,k) at (i h_x, j h_y, k h_z)
authoring_contract.net_force_without_terminals: identically zero at convergence: force peak and impulses vanish for insulated conductors; use torque and force-density responses
authoring_contract.terminal_sign: current_A is the current flowing INTO the domain through the patch; a ground terminal is held at 0 V and returns the net current
authoring_contract.terminal_contact: mean occupancy of the cells under every terminal patch must reach the host solid_reporting_threshold on the evaluated design
authoring_contract.gauge: ground terminal, otherwise a zero-mean potential multiplier (exactly zero at convergence)
authoring_contract.response_norms: normalised p-mean (sum_s w_s |a_s|^p)^(1/p) over the listed samples with equal weights summing to one (every native tetrahedron has the same volume, so equal element weights are volume weights); bounded by the true maximum and at least N^(-1/p) times it for N samples
limitations: Quasistatic magnetic field: prescribed spatially uniform B(t); the self-field of the solved currents, magnetic diffusion/skin effect, displacement current, motion-induced EMF and magnetisation are neglected. Valid when mu0*sigma*L^2/dt << 1 (reported per step).
Induced field from the backward difference of B between host times (exact for piecewise-linear B(t)); Lorentz force and Joule heat sampled at the step endpoint, no structural inertia.

Terminals are ideal equipotential contacts on native box-face patches; no contact resistance, arcing or sheath effects. Each terminal must contact solid material: the mean occupancy of the cells under the patch must reach the host solid reporting threshold on the evaluated design.

Induced field gauge: with terminals and a changing field the result depends on the authored induction_gauge_origin_m, the point to which the external circuit leads run straight from every terminal (its return path links no further flux); insulated conductors are independent of it.
Without terminals the net force and its impulses vanish identically (charge conservation); the loads are then the torque and the local force density.
Isotropic conductivity linear in element-mean temperature per endmember with occupancy interpolation; fixed geometry (small strain).
Element-centroid quadrature: charge rows, element current integral and net force exact for the linear induced field; torque, local force density and Joule heat density second-order accurate.
Exclusive with resolved_electrothermal (independent potential solves do not superpose) and, when joule_heating is selected, with prescribed-field Joule heat (double counting).

study_template_text.label: Eddy-current loads from a uniform magnetic field
study_template_text.description: Enter the uniform flux density at every host time; its change between host times induces eddy currents in insulated conductors. The net force and impulses of an insulated conductor are identically zero; its loads are the torque (independent of the moment reference) and the local force density. Zero-load starter with placeholder conductivities; no experimental validation. Authored heat must exclude the Joule contribution.

study_template_text.label: Injected current between X-min and X-max
study_template_text.description: Ground on the whole X-min face and an equipotential current terminal on the whole X-max face; enter the current into the domain at every host time. Set the torque reference point (lower domain corner in the starter); a changing field additionally requires the induction gauge origin, the point where the external circuit leads meet. Zero-load starter with placeholder conductivities; no experimental validation. Authored heat must exclude the Joule contribution.
